primary_diagnosis_treated: Metabolic syndrome / insulin resistance with uncontrolled hypertension

medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends an ACE‑I as first‑line antihypertensive

medications.duration: Lifelong — review BP in 4 weeks then annually
medications.purpose: Second‑line antihypertensive to achieve target <140/90 mmHg
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends a CCB as preferred second‑line after ACE‑I when BP remains uncontrolled

medications.dose: 20 mg orally once daily in the evening
medications.duration: Lifelong — lipid profile review at 3 months then annually
medications.purpose: Primary prevention of CVD in metabolic syndrome (low HDL, obesity, hypertension)
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181/PH46 advise statin therapy for patients with QRISK ≥10% or metabolic‑syndrome components

medications.dose: 0.25 mg subcutaneous weekly, titrate to 1 mg weekly over 12 weeks
medications.duration: Continue lifelong — weight and glycaemic review at 3 months then annually
medications.purpose: Weight management in obesity (BMI ≥30) with hypertension and dyslipidaemia
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 (2024 update) supports GLP‑1 RA for BMI ≥30 kg/m² with comorbidities

interactions_checked.interaction: Amlodipine can modestly increase atorvastatin plasma concentrations, raising risk of myopathy
interactions_checked.action: Monitor CK if muscle pain develops; dose is acceptable

interactions_checked.interaction: Additive antihypertensive effect may cause symptomatic hypotension, especially after first amlodipine dose
interactions_checked.action: Check BP after 1 week; consider reducing lisinopril if symptomatic hypotension occurs

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – NICE NG136 and CG181 require renal function before dose adjustments; assumed eGFR ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m² for ACE‑I and statin safety.
Liver function tests not provided – required before initiating atorvastatin per NICE CG181.
Pregnancy status unknown – ACE‑I and statin are contraindicated in pregnancy; ensure effective contraception before prescribing.
Family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN2 not provided – contraindication for semaglutide; verify before initiation.
Baseline CK not provided – monitor for myopathy after starting atorvastatin.
Blood pressure target verification needed after adding amlodipine; schedule review in 4 weeks.
treatment_summary: The patient’s uncontrolled hypertension is intensified with amlodipine 5 mg added to existing lisinopril 10 mg, following NICE NG136. A moderate‑intensity statin (atorvastatin 20 mg) is started for primary CVD prevention per NICE CG181/PH46. For obesity, semaglutide is introduced as a GLP‑1 RA per NICE NG28, with titration to 1 mg weekly. Interactions are mild to moderate and manageable with monitoring. Ongoing labs (eGFR, LFTs, CK, pregnancy test) are required before and after initiation. Lifestyle advice (diet, exercise, smoking cessation) should accompany pharmacotherapy.
